бы́ло]] [[простой|просты́м]], [[критик|кри́тики]] [[хвалить|хвали́ли]] [[оно|его́]].|Although the art piece was simple, critics praised it.

however, on the other hand (introduces something considered good or positive)
Я не зна́ю англи́йского, '''зато́''' я говорю́ по-калмы́цки.
I don't know English, '''but''' I '''do''' speak Kalmyk.

blocks.text: The exercises are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. The word in brackets is the dictionary form of the missing word.

exercises.q: How come these apples are wormy although they've been sprayed?
exercises.ru: Как так вышло, что яблоки червивые, ___ их и опрыскивали?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: She voted for Mr Nishioka irrespective of party lines.

exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: She arrived at school on time in spite of the blizzard.
exercises.ru: Она прибыла в школу вовремя ___ вьюгу.

exercises.q: Even though she was busy, she came to see me.

exercises.q: Although Arina is 16 years old, she imitates an adult woman well.

exercises.q: Even though South Tyrol is in Italy, the majority of the population speaks German.
